text: Westport Albion successfully shifted momentum in the final eight minutes leading to halftime by increasing their final third entries to 5 and applying effective pressing that gave them a field tilt of 55.8%, which disrupted Kingsmoor FC’s wide, crossing-based approach. Their direct, vertical passing in a 4-4-2 formation allowed them to regain possession higher up and create a scoring opportunity immediately after, as shown by Rafael Delacroix’s header shot. However, their low expected goals (0.05) and limited shots indicate room for improvement in finishing these chances. Coach Oduya should focus on sharpening the transition from recovery to effective final third execution to turn territory dominance into more concrete scoring threats.
